name: canvases.access.set
tokens: Live-verified 2026-09-25 with an xoxb: access_level=comment is accepted although docs only list read/write/owner; made-up values get invalid_arguments (must be a valid enum value). See methods/grid-admin-sandbox-2026-09.md.
purpose: Sets the access level to a canvas for specified entities

channel_ids.desc: List of channels you wish to update access for. Can only be used if user_ids is not provided.

user_ids.desc: List of users you wish to update access for. Can only be used if channel_ids is not provided.
